description: Pre-connect security audit for MCP servers — probes a remote MCP endpoint (auth, TLS, CORS, tools/list) and checks every tool for tool poisoning, prompt injection, hidden Unicode, embedded secrets, and dangerous capabilities (shell, file write, payments, credentials). Returns a safe_to_connect / connect_with_caution / do_not_connect verdict. Optional AI second opinion. (REST equivalent: POST /api/v1/mcp-server-security-scan, $0.25)

tools.description: Optional tools/list result to analyze (for local/stdio or auth-protected servers)

url.description: Remote MCP server URL (streamable HTTP, https)

name: mcp-server-security-scan
